div.p: Autonomy flows left to right. Red = enforcement: every path to a packet crosses one.

ul.li: Red — enforcement. Every route to a packet crosses the scanner scope gate.
Dashed — knowledge / feedback, not a dispatch path.
The scanner gate exists because a real agent scan bypassed the BFF one entirely.
Agent-output validation is the control aimed at the AGENTS, not the target: it checks claimed ports/CVEs/hosts against what the scans recorded.
target_kind splits recommendations that cannot be automated into manual follow-ups with the command, instead of failing silently.

g.title: Multi-agent pentest session — Scanner / Recon / Analyzer roles
Timer loop per engagement; drains the KB recommendation queue
mcp-server, mcp-streamable, mcpo, open-webui — LLM-callable tools
KB rules + LLM; emits scan_recommendations per (ip, service)
403 before any packet — covers the dashboard path
Where every path converges. Added after a real agent scan bypassed the BFF entirely
One implementation, three call sites. ip/cidr/domain/url, default-DENY, host-only
service | artifact | range | resource — non-service refused with a reason, not fired at an IP
Metasploit is never auto-exploited — queued for human approval
Regex + SQL, deterministic. Catches FABRICATED ports/CVEs/hosts. Unsupported can also mean ingestion broke
Public roots + the stack's self-signed cert, 14 services. Verification stays ON
Phase 1 top-1000 then Phase 2 full 1-65535 in parallel; phase 2 found 3632 distccd
ZAP -Xmx3g under a 6g cap; zap.sh reads only the cgroup v1 path
httpx, naabu, katana, tlsx, whatweb, ffuf
Allowlisted CLI tools — the fallback, not the default
msfrpcd over RPC; credentials must match on BOTH sides
assets, ports, vulns, findings, scope_targets, engagements, scan_recommendations, follow_up_items
port_profiles, web_profiles — single source of truth for scope presets
Per type: runs, targets, duration, what it PRODUCED, failures. produced_nothing flags silent breakage
Acted-on vs ignored recommendations by source; 'resource' kind excluded from the denominator
Anything needing a human gets a runnable command, wired to the real target
